hook.name: AlphaHook3Pct
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook for BNB Chain that adjusts LP fees (0.30%–3.00%) per pool based on an EMA of tick-movement volatility and swap volume. New pools launch at the fee ceiling and decay to the floor over ~10–15 minutes. An additional 20% protocol fee is charged on top of the LP fee via the afterSwap delta and swept to a fixed recipient.
